Results.ReviewText: Great smaller grill.  Love the grease control system.  Cooks steaks, burgers and chicken with nice sear marks.  Made well and hoping for years of use.

Results.ReviewText: Very pleased with our Weber BBQ! Perfect size for us. We want to BBQ more now!! Excellent product. The Weber app has some wonderful recipes and tips on how to grill the perfect meal!!
Results.Title: Great product

Results.ReviewText: My Weber has made grilling an art form! Each and every cooking experience has received raves from the family. Anxious to experiment. So far, steaks, chicken, sausages, burgers and clams have been perfection!

Results.ReviewText: This is a very good grill. It was easy to set up, use and clean.

Results.ReviewText: I love it. My favorite part is the wheels. It is so easy to maneuver. Next is the ignition switch. It is so easy to start. Next would be the grills and how easy they are to take out, put make in and clean. I like the cabinet for the gas tank and the fuel gauge as well. It is a great grill.

Results.ReviewText: Can’t beat the quality of both the grill, and the food it produces!
Results.Title: Quality

Results.ReviewText: The two cooking grates have a gap that keeps you from using the whole top, because burgers slip in the gap and you loose your burger.  Now that we have experienced this we certainly can adjust, but it’s not something you notice off the bat until your burgers slip through.
Results.Title: Gap between Grates

Results.ReviewText:
We bought the Weber two burner grill to replace a very old 4 burner grill.  Our son-in-law has the exact same grill and he highly recommend it.  Our neighbors also have a Weber grill and they love it.

I love cooking on this grill, the temperature is easily maintained, the grates clean up so well, and Gosh! the food cooks up beautifully.  So easy to use.
Results.Title: Love my new Weber E-210 gas grill

Results.ReviewText: For its size & capabilities, a great buy.  Should have gotten the 3 burner.  Solidly made & reliable.

Results.ReviewText: Weber is a quality brand and lives up to this reputation, the Spirit E-210 is the perfect size for my wife and I.
Results.Title: Spirit E-210

Results.ReviewText: Starts right up, maintains heat well.   My only issue is that you can actually see the flames when cooking, they have some sort of shield on top of them, presumably to deflect meat drippings.   If they could change this design, it would've gotten 5 stars.
Results.Title: Good grill, appears to be well-made

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Spirit, and I just love them.  They are smaller, perfect for the smaller family or smaller patio, easy to maintain, they grill well and use less gas.  Perfect!

I love how it’s design first of all.
Battery lite ignition, the tray that runs into a grease pan, and the scale that weights the gas in your tank.  A very good and smart design.
It cooks very fast, I’m still learning how to adjust the heat temperature on this spirit E-210 .
It is the best grill I ever owned..

Being a single person it's just the right size. Cooks Steaks, Chops, and Burgers evenly. everything comes out perfect.
 it's very easy to clean too eith removable trays. I love it!!

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
